title: coap: Use RFC 7959 notation for block options
description:
This updates the output of the block option part in tshark to match the
notation used in [example section of RFC 7959][1]. Here are two example
outputs to showcase the old and new behavior:

| Opt    | NUM | MORE | SZX | RFC         | tshark before     | tshark now        |
|:------ |:--- |:---- |:--- |:----------- |:----------------- |:----------------- |
| Block2 | 3   | 0    | 3   | `2:3/0/128` | `End of Block #3` | `Block2: 3/0/128` |
| Block1 | 5   | 1    | 0   | `1:5/1/16`  | `Block #5`        | `Block1: 5/1/16`  |

At least to me, the new format is a lot more useful, as it provides all
the relevant details in about the same amount of chars.

[1]: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7959#section-3.1

notes.body:
And here an example output from before:

```console
$ ./tshark -i tap0 -Y 'coap'
Capturing on 'tap0'
    2 28.314791004 fe80::24de:d0ff:fe85:bdb2 64635 5683 fe80::9826:30ff:feb8:31f4 CoAP 85 CON, MID:51609, GET, Block #1, /.well-known/core
    3 28.315468102 fe80::9826:30ff:feb8:31f4 5683 64635 fe80::24de:d0ff:fe85:bdb2 CoAP 112 ACK, MID:51609, 2.05 Content, End of Block #1, /.well-known/core
    4 28.316200113 fe80::24de:d0ff:fe85:bdb2 64635 5683 fe80::9826:30ff:feb8:31f4 CoAP 85 CON, MID:51610, GET, Block #2, /.well-known/core
    5 28.316578191 fe80::9826:30ff:feb8:31f4 5683 64635 fe80::24de:d0ff:fe85:bdb2 CoAP 71 ACK, MID:51610, 2.05 Content, End of Block #2, /.well-known/core
```

and after:

```console
$ ./tshark -i tap0 -Y 'coap'
Capturing on 'tap0'
    1 0.000000000 fe80::24de:d0ff:fe85:bdb2 64635 5683 fe80::9826:30ff:feb8:31f4 CoAP 85 CON, MID:51609, GET, Bock2: 1/0/128, /.well-known/core
    2 0.000677098 fe80::9826:30ff:feb8:31f4 5683 64635 fe80::24de:d0ff:fe85:bdb2 CoAP 112 ACK, MID:51609, 2.05 Content, Bock2: 1/0/64, /.well-known/core
    3 0.001409109 fe80::24de:d0ff:fe85:bdb2 64635 5683 fe80::9826:30ff:feb8:31f4 CoAP 85 CON, MID:51610, GET, Bock2: 2/0/128, /.well-known/core
    4 0.001787187 fe80::9826:30ff:feb8:31f4 5683 64635 fe80::24de:d0ff:fe85:bdb2 CoAP 71 ACK, MID:51610, 2.05 Content, Bock2: 2/0/64, /.well-known/core
```

(Note that the behavior of both server and client is incorrect. The new output makes this easy to see.)

I would prefer "Block%u" here.
```suggestion:-0+0
		col_append_fstr(pinfo->cinfo, COL_INFO, ", Block%u: %u/%u/%u",
```
